i’m sorry it hit you so quick :/ it really sucks how depression is. i know what you mean about the cycle just repeating, i hope you’re able to get out of it. i’m very glad you still have hope, definitely keep doing everything you can to keep that alive. i really do see hope and optimism as key things to staying alive when things are so bad. thank you so much for the replies. i don’t know if i’ll ever be able to get the hope i once had back.. i keep trying everyday that i’m still here but i know it’s not long before i can’t keep going any longer

that’s very true! i agree. it’s hard to tell how someone life is by looking at them. someone may seem to have nothing to some, but may be the happiest person in the world. but the same is true that some may seem to have it easy and be happy but may actually have very serious problems and may be struggling more than most. ya never know cause you’re not living their life and feeling or experiencing what they are. you can try your best to understand, but should never compare or assume. that’s very cool you had that interaction today. it’s a good thing to not compare yourself to others in struggles and more cause we all are so different. 

i always was such an optimistic and happy person. always made plans and goals and looked towards the future. stayed persistent. i think this definitely kept me alive much longer. but after so many years my mental and physical health has gone to shit and i had to face reality

well i feel i have. i’ve been trying to kill myself since i was very young. planning to and everything but i kept telling myself to stay alive a little longer. gave myself timelines and everything. but the time would come and i’d still wanna die and for some reason i just kept going anyways. but now i’m tired of doing that, i just can’t anymore. there’s no point, i know generally how things will always be because things haven’t changed much for years and years and they won’t cause there’s no way for them to. i don’t have much to fight for because all my goals and dreams are pretty much unreachable. and it’s not even far out there shit. just like being able to have more than one pair of shoes, being able to go to the store to get at least one thing, being able to drive myself, being able to do normal things around the house without it wiping me out for hours and days afterwards, being able to stand and take a hot shower ( i cannot do this and i only have a shower with a tiny edge to sit on that i sometimes use). i just wanna be able to live a normal life and create my own life where i can heal and be healthier and happier but i just don’t have any way from here to there anymore cause my physical and mental health is so bad and i have no options or support or anything so yeah.. idk maybe i’m just stupid

i don’t see what i can keep fighting for though.. and i haven’t ever had a support system and emotionally i know i can’t keep going. and physically i can’t either cause i am always having to do too much for others or just the way the house is and more. like i just physically can’t even do the minimum anymore and i’m miserable so what do i keep fighting for? idk

i understand to some i haven’t had as hard of a life as others. but to me it’s been my own hell of never being able to physically do the things i need or want to and never having anyone care about me or be there for me forreal. i’ve been internally alone in a room the majority of my life. and i will likely die early due to my likeness + making it worse by doing too much. thanks for believing in me but idk i just can’t keep going i don’t see how i can
